blocks.content: Shifted India's approach from restricting monopolies to promoting competition.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The framework was recommended by the landmark Raghavan Committee.
It represents a major policy shift from restricting monopolies to actively promoting market competition.
It was specifically designed to align India's legal and economic frameworks with global competition standards.
The Raghavan Committee is a high-frequency question topic in competitive exams regarding market regulation history in India.
Remember the fundamental paradigm shift: moving away from 'restricting monopolies' toward 'promoting competition'.

blocks.content: • Shifted India's approach from restricting monopolies to promoting competition.
• Designed to align Indian markets with global competition laws.
